messages:
Ava Chen: Draft of one-pager for enterprise Private Deploy + SLAs + Security ready for review. Need messaging, a short benchmark narrative, webinar tie-in, and inbound lead routing. Brief is in Drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/onepager-private-deploy (internal)

Marcus Rivera: I'll pull the latency/cost numbers — can we call out 99.9% SLA and p95 < 200ms for hosted / p95 < 300ms for dedicated? also need a short note on quantization tradeoffs.

Priya Shah: Suggest structure: problem (regulated customers), solution (private + SLA), proof (benchmarks + short case study), ops (deploy modes, KMS, audit logs), CTA (talk to solutions). Keep it to one page.

Jon Park: For inbound routing, sales wants leads flagged for privacy/regulatory interest and >= monthly commitment. Proposed routing rule: 
```yaml
source: marketing.form
utm_campaign: private-deploy-launch
tags: [security, sla, private-deploy]
min_mrr_usd: 5000
route_to: AE-Enterprise
priority: high
```

Ella Gomez: Design notes: need a hero with 2-line headline, 3 icons for deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), an SLA badge, and a tiny benchmark sparkline. I can mock the layout if we confirm final copy and benchmark numbers. Will keep to brand palette.

Ava Chen: Great — Marcus, can you confirm numbers by EOD? Jon, can you map those routing rules into HubSpot? Priya, want to pair on webinar script.

Jon Park: Yep I'll drop the rules into HubSpot and create a test contact. Quick sketch of trigger logic: 
```text
if form.tags contains "private-deploy" OR utm_campaign == "private-launch" then 
  assign -> AE-Enterprise
  lead_score += 20
  set lead_owner_group = "enterprise-opps"
end
```

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: https://drive.redwood/internal/assets/onepager_privatedeploy_v0.9.pdf

Priya Shah: Webinar plan (high level): 30m presentation + 15m Q&A. Speakers: CTO (infra story) + Head of Product (customer outcomes). Narrative: infra pain -> SLA/ops controls -> demo (deployment modes + canary/rollout) -> customer quote on security & cost. Suggested date: Apr 14. Invite list = customers & trials with >$5k MRR OR security/regulatory tag.

Marcus Rivera: Benchmarks draft: hosted p95 = 180ms (g4dn baseline), dedicated p95 = 260ms (A40 baseline), caching + prefix K/V yields ~3x token cost reduction on steady-state workloads. I'll export test harness commands and dataset notes.

Ava Chen: Awesome — I'll consolidate and prep the final one-pager and a handoff doc for Sales Ops + Events. Tag me on comments when you update the Drive. :rocket:

Ella Gomez: Mocking up hero and SLA badge now, will post PNG in thread when ready.

Priya Shah: Also adding a 2-line webinar blurb for the registration page and 3 talking points for the product demo.

Jon Park: I'll create the HubSpot workflow and add an automation to notify AE slack channel (#sales-enterprise) on high-priority leads.

Ava Chen: Thanks team — aim to ship the one-pager + webinar invite by end of week.
